The '''Eyar system''' was a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the site of<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[City/Legends|settlement]] known as [[Eyar City]] and shared its name with the [[Eyar Treatment Systems]] company that operated there.<ref name="HS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Eyar [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-10.<ref name="TEA" />
